_readme: Machine-readable catalog of the marketing component library (the Lovable design-system.json idea). The PreToolUse marketing-guard injects a digest of this file into every write/edit under app/(marketing)/** or components/marketing/**, so the full expressive range is in context on every generation — not just the archetypes the model happens to remember. Keep entries in sync when a component's props change; guard lines render as `Name(props) — use`.
contract: Every content block sits in <Section>/<Container>/<SectionHeader> — spacing/width come from marketing tokens, never per-page values
Tokens only: hsl(var(--token)) / token Tailwind classes; must look right in 4 color themes × light/dark
Headings: font-display text-display-{2xl,xl,lg,md} (fluid clamp scale, no breakpoint font jumps)
Copy through the marketing i18n namespace in ALL 5 locales (de,en,es,fr,pt-BR)
Icons only via @/icons/nexture/ni-* alias; meaningful concept icons, never decoration
Exactly one <h1> per page (Hero, or SectionHeader/PricingSection as/headingAs="h1")
New public routes: PUBLIC_PREFIXES (src/middleware.ts) + src/app/sitemap.ts + generateMetadata
Structured data via <JsonLd> only; Organization/FAQPage/Product already emitted by layout/Faq/PricingSection
Motion via <Reveal> or useGSAP in client components; transforms + autoAlpha; reduced-motion safe
Layer scale: compositions are relative isolate with z-0 (back) / z-10 (frame) / z-20 (front); z-30 is reserved for site chrome
Ambient motion is seasoning: max 4 <Float> + 2 <Parallax> per page, always reduced-motion safe; one orbiting decor at most

tones.rule: primary is reserved for CTAs and the page's one bold moment; categorical elements (plan tiers, feature families, chart series, icon chips) take accent hues with a CONSISTENT family→hue mapping across the whole site. A 100%-primary page reads monochrome and fails the premium bar.

components.name: AnamnesisCard
components.props: title, subtitle?, fields: {label, value?, state: clear|attention|empty, stateLabel}[], source?: {label, quote}, className
components.use: MedChina signature motif (docs/DESIGN.md): structured-anamnesis surface with per-field review states (jade=clear, terracotta=attention, neutral=empty) and optional provenance footnote; the hero frame media and the anamnesis/traceability evidence — fictitious data only (Helena Martins)

components.name: PhoneFrame
components.props: children (screen content), className · RecordingMock{patient, statusLabel, timer, pauseLabel, voiceLabel, finishLabel}
components.use: token phone chrome for the companion-app story (real screenshots when they exist); RecordingMock renders the Modo Consulta screen (recording state + timer + big actions) with translated labels

components.name: Section
components.props: spacing: default|compact, background: default|paper|primary-soft|contrast, decor: none|glow|grid|gradient-edge|dots|mesh|orbit, bleed, id
components.use: vertical rhythm unit wrapping every block; vary background/decor at least twice along a page (premium bar #3); orbit is the one slowly-alive ambient — max one per page

components.name: ProductComposition
components.props: frame (ProductFrame/screenshot), satellites: {children, position: top-left|top-right|right|bottom-right|bottom-left|left, depth: front|back, rotate: -6..6, float, floatDelay, parallax, hideBelow}[] (2–4)
components.use: LAYERED hero media — central frame + floating chips overlapping its edges (the reference-site look); collapses to a chip row below md; Hero's timeline choreographs frame then satellites (premium bar #9)

components.name: SatelliteChips
components.use: ready-made satellites for ProductComposition; REAL localized content only — a satellite that lies is worse than none

components.name: ProductShot
components.props: name (basename under /images/marketing), alt (translated), sizes, priority (above the fold only), width?, height?
components.use: REAL product screenshot pair (light + -dark) captured by npm run shots:marketing; use inside ProductFrame/Breakout media — real imagery beats any placeholder (premium bar #12)

components.name: Band
components.props: angle: -2..2, background: contrast|primary-soft|paper, spacing, decor: none|grid|dots, id
components.use: full-bleed ANGLED contrast strip — the diagonal-band breakout; background skews, content stays level; use INSTEAD of <Section> for that block (premium bar #10)

components.name: Breakout
components.use: media escaping the container to the viewport edge; use inside <Section bleed className="overflow-x-clip">; copy column stays aligned with the site container (premium bar #10)

components.name: Float
components.use: gentle infinite oscillation for satellites/decor; reduced-motion static; budget ≤ 4 per page

components.name: Parallax
components.use: scroll-scrubbed drift for layered media; desktop-only + reduced-motion safe; budget ≤ 2 per page

components.name: CountUp
components.use: numbers count up on scroll entry; SSR renders the final string (SEO/no-JS/reduced-motion correct); StatBand uses it internally

components.name: InView
components.use: one-shot data-inview attribute on viewport entry — the CSS hook for server-rendered draw-ins (DataVizPlaceholder uses it internally)

components.name: Container
components.use: token width clamp; Section renders it — direct use only with Section bleed

components.name: SectionHeader
components.props: eyebrow, title, subtitle, align: start|center, as: h1|h2
components.use: standard section heading; as="h1" on the first header of hero-less pages

components.name: Hero
components.props: layout: center|split, decor: glow|grid|none, media (evidence slot), eyebrow, title, subtitle, primaryCta, secondaryCta
components.use: owns the page <h1> AND the page's one orchestrated motion moment (built-in load timeline: copy staggers, media rises); split + <ProductFrame glow> is the committed direction for product-heavy pages; media is required in practice (premium bar #1)

components.name: ProductFrame
components.use: browser chrome for REAL product screenshots; token wireframe placeholder without children; glow = primary halo, the expensive-product hero treatment

components.name: DataVizPlaceholder
components.use: animated token-driven chart standing in for the screenshot on DATA products; CSS draw-in, reduced-motion safe

components.name: FeatureRows
components.props: items: {eyebrow?, title, body, bullets?, media, tone}, decor, id
components.use: alternating text↔evidence zig-zag for the 2–4 flagship features; use INSTEAD of a second card grid; decor="grid" makes it the page's technical section

components.name: BentoGrid
components.props: items: {title, body, visual?, featured?, tone} — 4–6 cells
components.use: asymmetric grid; featured cells span 2 columns and carry a visual; breaks equal-card monotony

components.name: StatBand
components.use: contrast+grid band of OVERSIZED numbers (display-2xl, mono index, tone gauge bar) that COUNT UP on entry; doubles as a background break; invented stats are worse than none

components.name: ProcessSteps
components.props: steps: {icon?, kicker?, title, body, deliverableLabel?, deliverableValue?, tone}, variant: icon|mono
components.use: scannable sequence: ghosted ordinal + meaningful themed icon + optional deliverable, one hue per step; variant="mono" swaps to a mono 0N · kicker label (instrument treatment)

components.name: FeatureGrid
components.use: benefit-led card grid, meaningful icon per family hue; never the only archetype on a page (premium bar #2)

components.name: Testimonials
components.use: quotes must carry a concrete outcome (numbers, before/after); initials avatars rotate harmonic hues, no stock photos

components.name: LogoCloud
components.use: client strip; muted wordmarks until real token-tinted SVG logos exist

components.name: PricingSection
components.props: plans (from getDisplayPlans()), ctaLabel, ctaHref, headingAs: h1|h2, decor, id
components.use: real plans, one highlighted anchor, tone per tier; emits Product JsonLd; CTA repeats the page's primary action verbatim; decor="glow" when it leads the page; 1–2 plans auto-center instead of stranding in a 3-up grid

components.name: Faq
components.use: REAL purchase objections (price, lock-in, security, migration) answered plainly; emits FAQPage JsonLd

components.name: Cta
components.props: title, subtitle, cta, kicker?, decor: none|orbit|mesh|dots
components.use: last conversion opportunity as a bordered console panel with primary glow + optional mono kicker; repeats the primary CTA verbatim; decor="orbit" is the classic closer

components.name: Reveal
components.use: the ONLY sanctioned scroll animation (transforms + autoAlpha, plays once, reduced-motion static); do NOT wrap every section uniformly — one orchestrated GSAP moment per page (premium bar #5)

components.name: JsonLd
components.use: the only way to emit structured data; never hand-write an ld+json <script>

components.name: Prose
components.use: long-form reading rhythm (legal pages, articles) without styling each element by hand
